concepts.title: 定义与几何要素
concepts.summary: 两焦点距离之和为常数 2a；长短半轴满足 $a^2=b^2+c^2$。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先分清中心、顶点、焦点和半轴，不把轴长当半轴。

en.title: Definition and geometric features
en.summary: The sum of distances to two foci is constant 2 a; the semi-axes satisfy $a^2=b^2+c^2$.

method.title: Method
method.body: Distinguish center, vertices, foci and semi-axes; halve full axis lengths.

method.title: 方法
method.body: 大分母为长半轴平方，配方时包括常数；检查空集、点与圆。

method.title: Method
method.body: The larger denominator is the squared semi-major axis. Complete squares including constants; check empty sets, points and circles.

concepts.title: 反射、拱桥与轨道
concepts.summary: 从一个焦点射出的波反射到另一个焦点。轨道最近最远距离为 a-c、a+c。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 按实际尺寸建立半椭圆或轨道模型；高度测自所指基线。

en.title: Reflection, arches and orbits
en.summary: Rays from one focus reflect to the other. The nearest and farthest orbital distances are a-c and a+c.

method.title: Method
method.body: Set up the semiellipse or orbit from dimensions, measuring heights from the stated baseline.

concepts.title: 离心率、交点、切线与面积
concepts.summary: 离心率 $e=c/a$，面积 $\pi ab$，通径长 $2b^2/a$。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 交点代入检验；切线使用隐式式以涵盖竖直情形。

en.title: Eccentricity, intersections, tangents and area
en.summary: Eccentricity is $e=c/a$, area is $\pi ab$, and latus-rectum length is $2b^2/a$.

method.title: Method
method.body: Check intersections by substitution; use implicit tangent form to include vertical tangents.

questions.prompt: 求有顶点 $(5,0)$、焦点 $(\pm4,0)$ 的椭圆标准式。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 根据中心与半轴写标准式，得 $\frac{x^{2}}{25} + \frac{y^{2}}{9}=1$。平方项的中心是 $(0,0)$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 较大分母给 $a^2=25$，较小分母给 $b^2=9$，故 $c^2=a^2-b^2=16$。沿长轴从中心加减 $a$ 得顶点，加减 $c$ 得焦点。

en.prompt: Find a standard equation of the ellipse with vertex $(5,0)$ and foci $(\pm4,0)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Use the center and semi-axes to write $\frac{x^{2}}{25} + \frac{y^{2}}{9}=1$. The center is $(0,0)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The larger denominator gives $a^2=25$, the smaller gives $b^2=9$, and $c^2=a^2-b^2=16$. Along the major axis, move by $a$ from the center for the vertices and by $c$ for the foci.

en.answer: Standard form $\frac{x^{2}}{25} + \frac{y^{2}}{9}=1$; center $(0,0)$; vertices $(-5,0)$ and $(5,0)$; foci $(-4,0)$ and $(4,0)$; major-axis length $10$ and minor-axis length $6$.
en.label: Example 1

steps.title: Calculate and reason

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 水平情形在焦点处取 $x=c$，则 $y^2=b^2(1-c^2/a^2)=b^4/a^2$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 端点 $y=\pm b^2/a$，长度为 $2b^2/a$。竖直情形交换 x 与 y，长度不变。

en.prompt: Show that the latus-rectum length of $\frac{x^2}{a^2}+\frac{y^2}{b^2}=1$ or $\frac{x^2}{b^2}+\frac{y^2}{a^2}=1$ is $2b^2/a$, where a is the semi-major axis.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: For a horizontal ellipse set $x=c$ through a focus. Then $y^2=b^2(1-c^2/a^2)=b^4/a^2$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The endpoints have $y=\pm b^2/a$, so the length is $2b^2/a$. Swapping x and y proves the vertical case.

en.prompt: Find the latus-rectum length of $\frac{x^2}{25}+\frac{y^2}{36}=1$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Normalize to get $a^2=36,b^2=25$. Substituting in $2b^2/a$ gives $ \frac{25}{3}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason

steps.title: Calculate and reason

en.prompt: Find the latus-rectum length of $5x^2+9y^2=45$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason

exercises.prompt: 有多少个半径3且同时与两坐标轴相切的圆？写出各方程。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 圆心到两轴的距离均为3，因此圆心 $(\pm3,\pm3)$ 的四种独立符号组合。

exercises.prompt: 有多少个长轴6、短轴4且同时与两坐标轴相切的椭圆？写方程。原题未明确说轴平行于坐标轴。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 在本节标准式（轴平行坐标轴）范围：水平长轴时半轴3、2，中心必须是 $(\pm3,\pm2)$；竖直长轴时中心为 $(\pm2,\pm3)$。每类4个，共8个。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 如果允许旋转，任取角 θ，中心横纵距分别为 $\sqrt{9\cos^2\theta+4\sin^2\theta}$、$\sqrt{9\sin^2\theta+4\cos^2\theta}$（各可正负），即可与两轴相切，故有无穷多个。原题不加方向限制不能唯一答8。

steps.title: 旋转形式的全部方程
steps.body: 允许旋转时，令 $h=\pm\sqrt{9\cos^2\theta+4\sin^2\theta}$、$k=\pm\sqrt{9\sin^2\theta+4\cos^2\theta}$（符号独立），则全部旋转解可写为 $((x-h)\cos\theta+(y-k)\sin\theta)^2/9+(-(x-h)\sin\theta+(y-k)\cos\theta)^2/4=1$。

exercises.answer: 轴平行条件下8个：$\frac{(x-h)^2}{9}+\frac{(y-k)^2}{4}=1$，$h=\pm3,k=\pm2$；或 $\frac{(x-h)^2}{4}+\frac{(y-k)^2}{9}=1$，$h=\pm2,k=\pm3$。允许旋转则无穷多个。

en.prompt: How many ellipses of major-axis length 6 and minor-axis length 4 touch both coordinate axes? Write the equations. The source does not explicitly require axes parallel to coordinate axes.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Within the standard forms in this section (axes parallel to the coordinate axes), horizontal semi-axes 3 and 2 require centers $(\pm3,\pm2)$; vertical orientation requires centers $(\pm2,\pm3)$. Each has four centers, giving eight.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: If rotation is allowed, for any angle θ choose absolute center coordinates $\sqrt{9\cos^2\theta+4\sin^2\theta}$ and $\sqrt{9\sin^2\theta+4\cos^2\theta}$, with independent signs. The rotated ellipse touches both axes, so there are infinitely many. Without an orientation restriction, eight is not the general count.

steps.title: Equations when rotation is allowed
steps.body: For arbitrary rotation let $h=\pm\sqrt{9\cos^2\theta+4\sin^2\theta}$ and $k=\pm\sqrt{9\sin^2\theta+4\cos^2\theta}$, with independent signs. The family is $((x-h)\cos\theta+(y-k)\sin\theta)^2/9+(-(x-h)\sin\theta+(y-k)\cos\theta)^2/4=1$.

en.answer: With axes parallel, eight: $\frac{(x-h)^2}{9}+\frac{(y-k)^2}{4}=1$, $h=\pm3,k=\pm2$; or $\frac{(x-h)^2}{4}+\frac{(y-k)^2}{9}=1$, $h=\pm2,k=\pm3$. Allowing rotation gives infinitely many.
